text: The friend holds title in fee simple subject to an executory limitation, and the sister’s children who reach 25 hold a shifting executory interest contingent on church use; the deceased son’s interest failed, and the daughter (and any later-born children) may take only if they reach 25 and the condition occurs within the perpetuities period. Because the class is not yet closed and the interest is contingent, the correct choice is the friend, the son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime. CONFIDENCE: 80
